about: Games v4 grading vectors (docs/games-v4/CONTRACT.md sections 5-7). The Dart session (lib/features/games/core) and the server's items_grade.grade must both give these numbers. valid=false: the trace is refused as a whole (the play is saved unranked, reason bad_trace). Items are in the snapshot form of a draw (section 4). duration_ms is the last entry's ms. too_fast: duration_ms < counted x min_step_ms. rank_points is computed for every valid case as if the play ranked.

srs.about: right on first try: the box goes up, due after the box's days
wrong (the item's score is below its max): back to box 1, due the next day
no row yet and right: no row is made (only a miss starts the ladder)
